trial_court: Additional District Judge (Matrimonial Cases), Jammu, RP No. 116/2022
facts_of_case: Suit filed by Amit Sharma against Rakhee Sharma under Section 13 of the Jammu and Kashmir Hindu Marriage Act. Suit was initially dismissed as the adulterer was not impleaded. Review petition filed and appeal allowed.

legal_principles.principle: A party must plead all grounds for divorce in the suit.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff had not pleaded adultery as a ground for divorce in the case filed by the husband as is evident from the averments made in the suit.

legal_principles.principle: A court must decide on the issue of cruelty independently.
legal_principles.held: The issue of cruelty could be determined independently in view of what had been pleaded and irrespective of the issue of adultery framed by the trial court.

legal_principles.principle: A party must raise the inapplicability of a rule when the appeal is heard.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner should have raised the inapplicability of Rule 10 when the appeal was heard.

legal_principles.principle: A court must consider the applicability of rules in the context of the relevant Act.
legal_principles.held: The applicability of 1970 Rules or more specifically Rule 10 of 1970 Rules if mandatorily continues to be applicable under the new Act of 1980 though the Rule was made under 1955 Act requires determination.

outcome.final_order: Suit to be heard on merits without being influenced by earlier observations.
